findings.title: Firestore rules open to everyone on a recursive wildcard
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one critical security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: firestore.rules:5
Issue: Firestore rules open to everyone on a recursive wildcard (CWE-284, A01:2025)
What to change: Require sign-in and ownership instead of an open rule: match /users/{userId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId; } match /posts/{postId} { allow read: if true; allow create: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.ownerId == request.auth.uid; allow update, delete: if request.auth != null && resource.data.ownerId == request.auth.uid; }

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "272a6e294b4f".
